samples.question: The card shows a 9 by 9 lattice of round printed marks, four small dark squares at the lattice corners, and one large colour patch above the lattice; that patch is the filter. Each mark is printed with one, two or three of the process inks cyan, magenta and yellow, and shows their mixture: cyan+magenta prints blue, cyan+yellow prints green, magenta+yellow prints red, and all three print black. Viewed through the filter, a mark looks dark exactly when its printing contains one particular ink - through a red filter the marks containing cyan, through a green filter the marks containing magenta, through a blue filter the marks containing yellow. Every other mark and every empty cell looks pale. The lattice cells that look dark through the shown filter form a shape that most closely matches one of these symbols: arch, arrow, ladder, ring, vee. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
